cs.t: I've got a cheap Asus K50, and it's been my friend for a long time. Good keyboard, audio, and brightness settings, and enough processing speed for my needs. The best part about it is that if I drop it in the bathtub I'm only out ~600 for a new one (I do my best programming in the bathroom, it seems).
